rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; reply-format error, not a tax reading. The DeepSeek reply for classm.s3.3 keys every line by its label text (printed: "Foreign tax credit") instead of the printed number requested ("1"), so the parser matched no line and the log shows MISSING. The value it gives, $0.00, is the project's $0.00, and its work ("No foreign tax", "Form 2441 line 11 = 0.00", "No Form 1095-A; Form 8962 line 26 = 0.00", the zero sums on lines 8 and 15) agrees with the return (f1040s3 lines 1 to 15, i1040gi p. 117). Nothing to drop: classm.s3.3.deepseek in fixtures/2025/classm.deepseek.json records no expectation for the case. The other three DeepSeek cases and all four Claude cases agree on every line.
